<!-- All news items below this line -->
;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[Basque conflict]]
**[[Basque nationalism|Basque separatist group]] [[ETA (separatist group)|ETA]] (Euskadi Ta Askatasuna), which waged an insurgency against [[Spain]] between 1959 and 2011, announces its complete dissolution. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2018/may/02/basque-separatist-group-eta-announces-dissolution (''The Guardian'')] 
*[[2018 Gaza border protests]]
**A fire started by an incendiary device attached to a kite by [[State of Palestine|Palestinian]] protestors and flown into [[Israel]] burns for six hours. It is the largest fire so far after a string of firebombing attacks. [https://www.timesofisrael.com/palestinian-fire-kites-spark-huge-blaze-in-israeli-fields-along-gaza-border/ (''The Times of Israel'')]
*A random shooting in [[al-Tarmia District]], [[Baghdad Governorate]], [[Iraq]], kills at least eight people and wounds at least fourteen. The gunmen responsible remain at large and unidentified. [https://www.iraqinews.com/iraq-war/22-iraqis-killed-wounded-in-random-shooting-attack-in-baghdad/ (Iraqi News)]
*The [[UK]] [[Royal Air Force]] admits killing a civilian with a drone strike in [[Syria]], the first time the force has accepted responsibility for civilian deaths in the country since starting operations there four years ago. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2018/may/02/syria-raf-airstrike-kills-civilian-uk-campaign (''The Guardian'')]
;Business and economy
*[[Multiannual Financial Framework]]
**The [[European Commissioner for Budget and Human Resources]] [[Günther Oettinger]] formally unveils proposed budget rules for the [[European Union]] to run from 2021 to 2027. [https://www.politico.eu/article/eu-budget-live-mff-multiannual-financial-framework-blog/ (''Politico'')]
*[[Facebook–Cambridge Analytica data scandal]]
**[[Cambridge Analytica]] announces that it is closing down as a result of the scandal. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/business-43983958 (BBC)]

;Disasters and accidents
*[[Malaysia Airlines Flight 370]]
**Searches led by [[Seabed Constructor|Ocean Infinity]] move to a new section of the [[Indian Ocean]] after the initial search area was cleared without success. If the missing aircraft, which was carrying over 200 people, is not found by mid-June the search will be called off. [http://www.scmp.com/news/asia/southeast-asia/article/2144321/mh370-us-search-team-extends-indian-ocean-mission-after (''The South China Morning Post'')]
*[[2018 U.S. Air National Guard C-130 crash]]
**A [[Puerto Rico Air National Guard]] [[Lockheed C-130 Hercules|C-130 Hercules]] transport plane crashes during a training flight near [[Savannah, Georgia]], United States, killing all five crew members and four passengers.  [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-georgia-crash/u-s-military-c-130-plane-crashes-during-training-survivors-unlikely-idUSKBN1I32C5 (Reuters)] [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-43983718 (BBC)]
*Firefighters say 44 people are missing after the collapse of the [[Edifício Wilton Paes de Almeida]] tower block in [[São Paulo]], [[Brazil]], yesterday. One missing man was within seconds of rescue when the building came down during a fire. [https://www.japantimes.co.jp/news/2018/05/02/world/44-missing-sao-paulo-squatter-building-blaze-collapse-firefighters/ (''The Japan Times'')]

;International relations
*[[North Korea–United States relations]]
**[[North Korea]] has released the three remaining [[List of foreign nationals detained in North Korea#List of detained US citizens|American detainees]] ahead of the upcoming [[2018 North Korea–United States summit|summit]] meeting with [[Donald Trump]] and [[Kim Jong-un]]. The news came after [[National Security Advisor (United States)|National Security Adviser]] [[John R. Bolton]] stated that they should be released as a way for North Korea to demonstrate its sincerity in talks. [http://www.businessinsider.com/north-korea-releases-us-prisoners-2018-5 (''Business Insider'')]
;Law and crime
*[[Mueller special counsel investigation]]
**[[Robert Mueller]] suggests that he could order a subpoena in order to get [[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[Donald Trump]] to testify to the investigation. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-43971954 (BBC)]
*A [[Texas|Texan]] teenager inspired by [[Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant|ISIL]] is arrested after threatening a [[mass shooting]] at a mall. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-shooting-arrest/texas-teenager-arrested-for-allegedly-plotting-mass-shooting-at-mall-authorities-idUSKBN1I32BS (Reuters)]
;Politics and elections
*[[Abortion in the United States]]
**[[Iowa House of Representatives|Iowa's House of Representatives]] approves a bill restricting [[abortion]]s in the state. If approved by [[Republican Party (United States)|Republican]] [[Governor of Iowa|Governor]] [[Kim Reynolds]], abortions after six weeks of pregnancy will be banned. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-us-canada-43978510 (BBC)]
;Science and technology
*[[Discoveries of exoplanets]]
**[[Helium]] has been detected for the first time in the atmosphere of an [[exoplanet]] by scientists observing [[WASP-107b]]. [https://newatlas.com/helium-discovered-exoplanet-atmosphere-hubble/54462/ (News Atlas)]
*[[NASA]] announces it has completed its first full-power test of the [[Kilopower]] [[Nuclear power in space|nuclear reactor for space]]. NASA intends to use the technology to power exploration missions to the [[Moon]] and [[Mars]]. [https://www.independent.co.uk/news/science/nasa-kilopower-nuclear-power-space-reactor-latest-update-mars-moon-energy-a8332746.html (''The Independent'')]
